routes.evidence: A4-3 the owner's policy matrix: every account and the Governance capabilities it holds.
A4-3 immutable delegation lineage for one account, including refusals — a trail of only what worked cannot answer 'why does Stan still not have this'.
A4-3 grant a capability from the finite §20.3 namespace. Step-up, idempotency and external_effect NONE.
A4-3 revoke a grant, pinned to its revision. Effective on the next authorization decision; there is no cache.
A4-2 owner roster. Excludes hashes, tokens, Cloudflare subject/email, session ids and audit internals — asserted in matrix.spec.
A4-2 account detail plus the operation history, including each entry's rollback description.
A4-2 create invited. Deliberately mints no credential: the one view happens when the owner asks for it.
A4-2 update display name / base role, pinned to an expected account revision.
A4-2 issue activation. Step-up required; non-replayable — a repeat returns REPLAYED without the credential.
A4-2 revoke sessions. Step-up required.
A4-2 disable. Step-up required; refused for the anchored owner.
A4-2 enable. Step-up required; never revives an old password — issues a fresh activation.
A4-2 archive access, which is what 'delete' means here. Step-up required; no row is deleted.
A4-2 current step-up state for this session, so the UI can say 'expired' rather than silently re-prompting.
A4-2 owner re-authentication. The only password this control plane handles is the caller's own.

P09 serves the immutable Journey descriptor plus P02 inspection-only cursor semantics through one session/workspace-scoped same-origin read. It has no write, worker, source-data, engine or Execution authority; Claude owns the first mounted S00 product receipt.

P09 reads the already-loaded P04 manifest through a bounded signed private GET and exposes current/historical, route and mode facts only. It cannot import or dispatch QuantBT; Claude owns the first mounted S12 product receipt.

P08 creates one bounded, immutable Research preflight manifest from a caller-scoped requested_spec. It does not create a run, start a worker, expose raw market rows, or reserve compute. The typed Screen 02/05 consumer exists; P09 owns the first product-route receipt and P10 owns run creation.

P10 accepts only one canonical, caller-scoped New Run request after rechecking the P08 opaque manifest, immutable P04 binding and server-owned admission predicate. It persists the intent before the private signed Portal hop; browser input has no worker lease, source path, broker, execution or CLI authority. Claude owns the Screen 02 typed consumer and browser receipt.

P10 ADMIN-only setup verifies or installs the one source-controlled immutable P04 Delta binding. The request has no code, source, path, digest, dependency or adapter selector; it cannot turn an imported AlphaVersion into executable Python. Claude may surface the typed state but does not choose the binding.

P08 reopens only the caller-and-workspace-scoped immutable preflight metadata behind its opaque token. It is an explicit interaction read, not a raw snapshot, replay, worker, or run API. The typed Screen 02/05 consumer exists; P09 owns the first product-route receipt and P10 owns run creation.

W4 CG-P08-04: bounded read-only research dataset catalog (datasets, timeframes, availability, symbols with month-partition coverage) from the approved historical reader's storage names through a signed private GET. No data file is opened and no path or price is returned. Screen 02's data step consumes it.
P07 publishes the bounded, caller-specific registry envelope for Screen 14. The generated client and fixture composition exist; P09 alone owns mounting the product route and its browser receipt.
P07 bounded same-origin source custody: the server accepts one capped module and returns only a read-only mirror/opaque receipt. The typed Screen 14 client exists; P09 owns product-route activation.
P07 records seven ordered server gates over the exact opaque source receipt; a failure makes remaining gates SKIPPED. The typed Screen 14 client exists; P09 owns product-route activation.
P07 creates or replays an immutable DRAFT AlphaVersion only from current passing server evidence. The typed Screen 14 client exists; P09 owns product-route activation.
P07 ADMIN-only CAS activation. may_activate is server-derived from this exact policy, while P09 owns the first mounted product-route/browser receipt.

P11 same-origin snapshot read projects only the committed structured worker journal under session/workspace scope. It has no source path, worker lease, broker, CLI or raw-console authority; Claude owns the S03 consumer and browser receipt.

W2 CG-P11-07 read-only clone source: the immutable requested_spec of a run the session/workspace may read, fetched only when the user opens New Run from a failed/cancelled run (?from=). A clone is a fresh preflight + NEW intent; this read creates, retries or mutates nothing.

P11 bounded SSE read replays persisted sequence facts and has typed terminal/backpressure frames. It is session/workspace checked and deliberately exposes neither internal lease fields nor a browser retry/command protocol; Claude owns S03 stream cleanup evidence.

P11 returns at most 500 explicit structured console observations from the immutable progress journal. It never parses or returns raw stdout, source paths, full logs or worker connection metadata; Claude owns the S03 bounded console-ring receipt.

P11 ADMIN-only, CSRF/origin-protected cancellation first wins the Control API durable-job CAS, then attempts a narrow private marker for the exact current lease. It cannot retry, start a worker, alter a sealed artifact or become a generic CLI route; Claude owns the S03 cancel-race receipt.
P05 retained artifact reservation: exact research_progress_writer principal, current P06 lease/fencing, feature gate and workspace scope; never browser or general CLI authority.
P05 retained artifact seal is forbidden to browser and general CLI by design: exact worker principal, current lease/fencing and manifest/part digest validation only.

W1 RS-02 current-source row ingest is forbidden to browser and general CLI by design: exact worker principal, current lease/fencing, a SEALED P05 artifact of the same revision and manifest digest, per-kind payload schemas, at most 200 rows and 1,000,000 bytes per batch.

W1 RS-02 current-source seal is forbidden to browser and general CLI by design: exact worker principal, current lease/fencing, Delta WFO execution profile only; requested/effective/dataset digests come from run_producers, never from the body.

W5a A10c WHATIF_GRID seal is forbidden to browser and general CLI by design: exact worker principal, current lease/fencing, what-if execution profile only; the results must answer exactly the admitted evaluations from the diagnostic run's own SEALED P05 artifact (PostgreSQL trigger); immutable once written; the frozen parent run is never written.

P11 infrastructure-only private callback: it requires the short-lived signed research_progress_writer principal and the exact current P10/P06 lease before materialising a worker journal event. It is forbidden to browser, facade, Execution Edge, source database and CLI callers by design.

P12 bounded same-origin persisted Run Library reader: signed opaque keysets, exact workspace-scoped totals, trigger-maintained search projection and explicit legacy/metric absence. It cannot scan artifacts/Parquet, read a worker/source database or create a run; Claude owns the S01 typed product consumer and browser receipt.

P12 lazy Screen-01 sparkline boundary validates the session/workspace-scoped run ID and returns at most 24 exact decimal strings. Current P12 refuses artifact/Parquet reads, so an unavailable series is explicit rather than a fabricated curve; Claude owns placeholder and browser evidence.

P13 bounded same-origin Evidence Flow Hub reads only one immutable Portal projection under session/workspace scope. It never starts QuantBT, scans an artifact/Parquet dataset, exposes worker or lease identity, or lets the browser choose a revision; Claude owns the Screen 04 rich typed consumer and browser receipt.

P13 lazy named Evidence Flow chart read returns one at-most-192-value exact-decimal series bound to the Hub revision. It rejects relation/cursor/path/worker input and represents source absence as a typed empty series; Claude owns Screen 04 drilldown, revision rejection and browser evidence.

P14 bounded same-origin Split reader returns one immutable current-P04 chronology projection under session/workspace scope. It retains typed non-publication for advanced folds, purge/embargo, strict selection, source seal and holdout unlock; it never reads snapshot/Parquet data, exposes a worker/lease/path, returns a holdout result or creates an action channel. Claude owns Screen 05 typed consumer and browser receipt.

P15 bounded same-origin Search reader consumes only the immutable P10/P14 current-P04 projection. It publishes the exact fixed parameter profile plus typed study/ledger/diagnostic absences; it cannot start an optimizer, infer a trial from progress, scan worker/artifact/Parquet data, expose a cursor/lease/source path, or create an action channel. Claude owns Screen 06 typed consumer and browser receipt.

P16 bounded same-origin Freeze reader consumes one immutable P10/P14 current-P04 receipt and returns only three retained digest-binding checks. It never reads source artifact bytes, starts a worker or diagnostic, changes frozen parameters, exposes source/custody inputs, or creates a command path. Claude owns Screen 07 typed consumer and browser receipt.

P16 explicit same-origin CSRF/origin-protected verify. It re-reads the retained bindings and (W5a A10a, FEATURE_RESEARCH_ARTIFACT_BYTE_VERIFY) re-hashes the run's sealed P05 artifact through the private observer, appending one immutable bounded receipt (research.artifact_byte_receipts_v1). It never rewrites an expected digest, opens no path for the browser, queues no diagnostic and has no command effect; PARTIAL_MATCH is never 'chain intact'.

W5a A10c explicit same-origin CSRF/origin-protected 'evaluate grid' action (FEATURE_RESEARCH_WHATIF). Admits at most one bounded DIAGNOSTIC Research job (own attempt, DIAGNOSTIC_OF_RUN run, ≤81 unique evaluations, deduplicated by grid key) through the P10 producer → P06 claim → Portal child path; never on a GET, mount or slider move; never writes the frozen parent run.

P17 bounded same-origin route-aware replay reader consumes only the immutable P13 OOS equity sample receipt under session/workspace scope. Its signed opaque cursors bind workspace/run/revision and select retrospective equity samples only; it never starts QuantBT, reads source/worker/artifact/Parquet paths, exposes custody values or cursor inputs, synthesizes order/fill/trade/position/candle history, or creates a command channel. Claude owns the Screen 08 typed consumer and browser/HiFi receipt.

P18 session/workspace-scoped immutable Report reader returns a Portal-sealed P13--P17 fixed-profile core plus a separate mutable annotation source. It never reruns QuantBT, reads an artifact/source path, exposes an opaque replay cursor or treats an annotation as frozen proof; Claude owns Screen 09 print/browser receipt.

P18 same-origin CSRF/origin-protected request creates at most one caller-owned bounded JSON/CSV transform job for a sealed report revision. It never starts a QuantBT run, modifies business evidence, opens a source/archive path or accepts a browser filename.

P18 caller-owned export status is workspace- and user-bound. It exposes no worker lease, source path, raw artifact metadata or bytes before READY; foreign job IDs are indistinguishable from absent ones.

P18 authenticated bounded download reads only a caller-owned READY row after SHA-256 verification. Server-derived JSON/CSV attachment names, private no-store headers and a 512 KiB hard limit prevent path/CSV/scratch-disk exposure; it has no command or compute effect.

P19 bounded same-origin Attempt Lineage reader returns only scoped Portal-persisted Alpha/version/attempt/run/exposure facts and server-normalized immutable semantic diffs. It cannot submit, fork, reproduce or upgrade a run; choose a promotion from lifecycle/recency/metrics; reset a gate; read QuantBT/worker/artifact/source storage; or expose raw config, paths, credentials, leases or cursors. Claude owns Screen 10 typed product/browser receipt.

P20 bounded same-origin Compare reader scopes all run IDs to one Alpha/workspace and returns attempts, market small multiples, or an exact two-run pair only. A mismatched ComparisonContractKey is REFUSED with pair:null; correlation is Portal-derived only from sealed local exact-timestamp raw returns with formula/version/n/missing-policy disclosure. It cannot read a browser-supplied relation/cursor/source path, start QuantBT, mutate evidence, choose/publish/promote a run, approve a gate, or issue an Execution command. Claude owns Screen 13 typed product/browser receipt.

P21 same-origin Screen-11 composer reads a bounded Portal-persisted run/Alpha/selection/audit/evidence view and returns exactly 17 source-built fields plus 12 evidence items. It does not expose a source relation/cursor/path/worker identity, invoke QuantBT, or represent a local seal as delivery or approval; Claude owns the typed S11 consumer and browser/HiFi receipt.

P21 same-origin CSRF/origin-protected actor-local declaration CAS. It changes only bounded known-limitations/proposed-use-restrictions under source-fingerprint and revision fences; it cannot seal, publish, approve, start QuantBT, change a bound Alpha/version, or call Execution.

P21 same-origin CSRF/origin-protected local seal stores one idempotent immutable Portal evidence pack and retention pins. Its only returned lifecycle is NOT_DELIVERED/NOT_APPROVED; P22 owns all downstream publication, Governance and Execution effects.

P21 workspace-scoped immutable local pack read returns frozen 17/12 evidence plus a separately typed downstream delivery/approval state. It exposes neither a generic research relation nor any mutable approval surface; a foreign RC is indistinguishable from absent.

RS-02 named retained-current-source Evidence Hub read: session/workspace scoped Portal-local sealed QuantBT 1.1.1 Advanced WFO facts only. It does not invoke QuantBT, reopen private P05 bytes, expose a relation/artifact/lease input, or replace P13 fixed-run v1.

RS-02 named lazy current-source series read returns at most 192 retained/derived exact-decimal points. Sampling metadata is server-owned; the browser cannot request a raw relation, a source path, an artifact cursor or a recomputation.
RS-02 named Split read maps only retained Advanced WFO fold facts and exact typed data-use absences. It cannot infer purge, embargo, holdout access or source semantics not published by the engine.

RS-02 named Search drill-down returns the bounded retained trial/candidate ledger with private no-store relation-bound cursors. It cannot start an optimizer, scan P05 directly or turn a trial choice into a mutation.

RS-02 named Freeze read verifies immutable Portal-retained manifest, row-count and batch-receipt facts. GET never reopens private source artifact bytes, changes frozen selection or queues a what-if evaluation.

RS-02 named Replay drill-down returns retained research-model observations and opaque relation-bound playheads, private/no-store. It never fabricates broker orders, fills or candles and does not claim execution state.

phase_2_round_2: The mirror recorded gaps and conflicts that no route and no screen read. This publishes the aggregate only: entity_key, row_id and the payload digests stay in the database.
